ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels constitute approximately 90% of the visible surface, providing high contrast against the black trailing edge and focal dark marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white lobes. One distinct dark circular spot in the upper right quadrant. Diffuse pinkish-tan mottled patches in the lower central region. Fine black clusters on the distal lower margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serrations; right lobe margin features high-amplitude peaks (8-12 pixels) while left lobe features lower-amplitude, more frequent peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white spots on the black-pigmented trailing tips of both lobes; single high-contrast black circular spot on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical pinkish-tan linear marks on the left lobe; fine horizontal grey linear pixel disruptions on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct circular black mark on the right lobe surface; large diffuse pinkish patches across the lower half of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small group of three discrete dark spots on the lower margin of the left lobe.
